assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: FINAL PRODUCTION iOS AppIcon bitmap, a single square full-bleed opaque icon, ideally 1024x1024.
Input image 1 is the exact USER-APPROVED icon concept. Extract and faithfully finish ONLY the LARGE CENTRAL BURGUNDY ICON from this presentation board. Keep exactly its approved artwork: four warm-white hand-ink book spines increasing gently in height from left to right, fourth leaning slightly out, charcoal contours and page-top strokes, four low waist bands burgundy/teal/blue/gold, and the large custom dark-burgundy serif "NCE" wordmark across the blank CENTER OF THE BOOK SPINES. Preserve NCE's expressive thick ink strokes and readable N C E letters, its centered size and position, and the balanced original book arrangement. No text in the upper-left background. Maintain elegant adult literary ink-print illustration and quiet burgundy background.
Production transformation ONLY: REMOVE the white presentation board, "I2" heading, small duplicate icons and ALL exterior margins. REMOVE the pre-rounded outside icon mask by extending the SAME burgundy background all the way to all FOUR SQUARE CORNERS and every edge. The final image itself is one full square solid burgundy field with the approved book artwork centered and generous original edge clearance. iOS will supply its own rounded mask. No rounded outer tile inside a white or transparent square. No white corner triangles, no frame, no transparency, no drop shadow or alternate graphics. All four books remain entirely visible. NCE remains ON the book centers, not above, below or in a badge. Do not redesign into a toy, glossy 3D, photograph or new book logo. Output exactly ONE icon asset and nothing else.
assets.reference_role: approved center-NCE icon; remove presentation and system mask for production

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: FINAL PRODUCTION single book-cover bitmap for an offline English-learning app.
Input image 1 is the USER-APPROVED C LINE ART cover comparison board, an exact design reference. Extract and faithfully finish ONLY the specified cover, preserving its serif title layout, delicate charcoal ink illustration, restrained accent wash, airy pale-white paper surface, and footer. No different art style or new cover concept.
Output exactly ONE flat front-facing portrait cover, aspect ratio EXACTLY 5:7 (for example 1000x1400), with that cover's paper filling ALL edges, no surrounding presentation board, no external white margins, no outside shadow, no tilted physical book mockup, no perspective, no rounded corners. Do not include the board heading, icon, other covers, author names or publisher logos.
Exact header: "New Concept" on the first line and "English" on the second, centered dark-charcoal elegant serif, at the same relative top position as the approved C cover. Title uses normal capitalization, not ALL CAPS. Plenty of white space. Center illustration occupies about the middle 40 percent; retain the approved illustration's hand-drawn character and visible objects. Footer "BOOK" plus the specified modest colored numeral centered near the bottom, with the same thin short rules above/below as the C series. No oversized central numeral.
Match the approved quiet adult illustrated literary-paperback design, not plastic 3D, photography, flat chunky clipart, ornate textures or toy-like doodles. No Chinese, Japanese or Korean text, no flags, labels, certifications, publisher affiliation or watermarks. Any handwritten page marks in the art should be minimal illegible texture, never borrowed printed passages. Entire cover readable and uncropped. Target: FIRST cover on the board, BOOK 1. Preserve its open book with delicate page strokes, burgundy talking bubble containing three small dots above the right pages, slender burgundy leaf branch to the left, and gentle burgundy accents at the bottom book edge. Footer exact "BOOK 1", with the numeral 1 in burgundy and BOOK in charcoal. Keep the original hierarchy and relative locations.
